EmailTemplate.subject: Recover your Username or Password
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello, [client]
Thank you for connecting with me for assistance in recovering a user name and/or password in Insperity Premier.
You can share the below information with your employee to assist them in this process.
Please let me know if you have additional questions.
[signature]
How to recover your Username or Password for Insperity's Employee Service Center
Below are the steps to recover your Username or Password for Insperity PremierTM
There are two links on the login page, one for Username and one for Password?
If you choose Username
Enter your email Choose how you would like to confirm your identity. You can either choose to answer your Security Questions or to have the system email you a verification code for you to enter.
Once you enter the answer to your security questions or the verification code, the system will display your username
Select Log In
You will be routed to the login screen to enter your username and new password
If you choose Password
Enter your username and email.
Choose how you would like to confirm your identity. You can either choose to answer your Security Questions or to have the system email you a verification code for you to enter.
Enter your new password
You will be routed to the login screen to enter your username and new password
Please call the Insperity Contact Center with additional questions at 866-715-3552.
